title: The Refund Your Records Missed
hook: You refunded the customer. But your sales report still says you earned the money.
script: You refunded the customer. But your sales report still says you earned the money. Here's how one return can confuse your business. A customer brings back a damaged item. The cashier returns the cash, but nobody records the refund or updates stock. At closing time, sales, cash and inventory no longer agree. The fix: log every return, its reason, the refund amount, and whether the item can be resold. Don't hide returns. Track them. Accurate records protect your profit.
